item.title: Compression is prediction
item.description: Compression and LLMs are trying to solve the exact same problem: predicting what comes next. Learn the fundamentals of compression and how better prediction leads to better shrinkage. (2 sources: hackernews, lobsters)

item.title: MCP Goes Stateless, and Developers Ask Whether That Just Makes It an API Again
item.description: The MCP 2026-07-28 specification removes the initialize handshake and session header, and adds required method and tool-name headers so gateways can route agent traffic without parsing JSON. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Mindful coding: Purpose and intention
item.description: Good code doesn't only describe what it does. It communicates why it exists. A look at how intent shapes names, abstractions, comments, and commit messages. (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: Bypassing Android Hardware Attestation from the Analyst's Chair
item.description: Hardware key attestation lets an Android app prove to its backend that a key lives in secure hardware on a locked, verified device. It is also the wall that stops a security analyst working on a rooted phone. (1 source: lobsters)

item.title: An Inside Look at the Relay Market Powering Token Resellers and Fraud
Facebook is paying controversial creators to produce rage-bait content
item.description: An ABC NEWS Verify investigation reveals Facebook is directly funding some controversial Australian content creators including a white nationalist and an anti-vaxxer influencer. (1 source: hackernews)
